key: A good family doctor in a small
name: ch15_doctor_lets_you_talk
alt: A family doctor lets a patient tell the whole story of her cough before speaking, so the patient is ready to listen to the advice.
scene: A small neighbourhood clinic in India: a wooden desk, a stethoscope, a BP machine, a calendar and a medicine cupboard with glass doors behind. RIGHT: the doctor, a woman in her 50s (white coat over an amber saree, spectacles), sits back in her chair with her pen put down and hands folded, leaning slightly forward and nodding, clearly listening. LEFT: the patient, a man in his 30s (plum checked shirt), sits on the stool talking with both hands, a long chain of small round bubbles rising from him and curling across the top of the picture like a story: a wedding garland, a crescent moon for worse at night, an air-conditioner box with a little mother face and a question mark, a cup of kadha with ginger and tulsi leaves. At the end of the chain, a small empty bubble shows he has said everything. Below, on the desk, a prescription pad waits blank and a small clock shows a few minutes have passed. Warm, patient mood; soft window light. A small hourglass on the desk is still full, showing the doctor is in no hurry. Label: "LISTEN FIRST" at the top right above the doctor.

name: ch15_saree_silent_seller
alt: A saree seller with a sore throat only unfolds sarees and smiles, while the customer's aunt praises the zari and convinces the family herself.
scene: Inside a traditional silk-saree shop in Kanchipuram: a raised floor covered with a white sheet, wooden shelves of folded silk sarees in jewel colours on the back wall. CENTRE-LEFT, seated cross-legged on the white sheet: the seller, a man in his 40s (white shirt, veshti, a woollen scarf round his throat), smiling silently with lips closed, unfolding a magenta silk saree with a wide gold border. RIGHT: the customer's family sitting on the sheet: an aunt in her 60s (teal saree, spectacles, grey bun) holds a saree end up to the light from the doorway, the gold zari shining, her mouth open mid-sentence; a young woman, the bride-to-be (coral salwar), and her mother lean in, nodding. Above the aunt a large speech bubble shows the zari thread up close with a green tick, and a smaller faded bubble shows another shop with a small cross. The seller has no speech bubble at all, only a tiny dotted empty one with a zipper-like line to show he cannot talk. A few unfolded sarees lie fanned out in the foreground. Warm golden light. Label: "THEY SELL IT" at the top above the family.

name: ch15_hostel_sunday_call
alt: Two Sunday calls: a parent's list of instructions gets a short reply, while one quiet caring question opens an hour-long conversation.
scene: A split-panel picture with a thin vertical divider. Both halves show the same scene: a small hostel room in Pune on the right side of each panel (bunk bed, study table, books) with a first-year student (18, grey hoodie) on a phone, and a small inset circle at the top left of each panel showing the parent at home (a father in his 50s, teal shirt) on the other end. LEFT panel: the parent's side sends a long list of icons with arrows into the phone: a plate of food, a rupee note, a book, a report card with a red mark. The student slouches with a bored face, and his reply is a tiny bubble. A small clock beside him shows only five minutes. RIGHT panel: the parent's inset shows him listening quietly with a gentle face and one short bubble with a question mark. Now the student sits up and talks, and a big bubble from him holds three small icons: two beds with a lightning bolt for roommate trouble, a book with a question mark, and a little house with a heart for homesickness. The clock beside him shows one hour. Labels: "LECTURE" above the left panel, "LISTEN" above the right panel, and "ALL FINE" in the student's tiny left bubble.

key: A young man goes with his parents
name: ch15_grandfather_one_loom
alt: A young man asks the bride's grandfather about his first loom and listens while the old man happily tells the story of building the business.
scene: A comfortable Indian living room during a family visit: a sofa with embroidered cushions, a low table with cups of tea and a plate of murukku, a framed photo of an old handloom on the wall. RIGHT: the grandfather, a man in his late 70s (white veshti and white shirt, white hair, thick spectacles) leans forward in an armchair, both hands moving, beaming as he talks. A large story bubble above him shows a small sequence joined by arrows: a single wooden handloom, rising flood water with a small house, and a lorry piled with cloth bales. LEFT: the young man in his late 20s (plum kurta) sits on the edge of the sofa, leaning in with an attentive smile, his tea cup held still; his parents (father in a teal shirt, mother in an amber saree) sit beside him, smiling at each other. A small wall clock shows forty minutes have passed. In a small corner inset at the bottom right, the grandfather pats the young man's shoulder at the door with a green tick. Warm, friendly evening light. Label: "ONE LOOM" under the handloom in the story bubble, and "40 MIN" beside the clock.

key: A flat broker in Bengaluru shows you
name: ch15_broker_lake_balcony
alt: A broker lists a flat's problems honestly, mentions the lake view and stays silent while the buyer talks himself into it on the balcony.
scene: An empty 2BHK flat in Bengaluru seen from inside, looking out through open balcony doors to a calm lake with trees and a distant skyline. RIGHT, on the balcony: the buyer, a woman in her early 30s (teal kurta, laptop bag on her shoulder) leans on the railing looking at the lake, with three small thinking-aloud bubbles rising from her: a laptop for working from home, a flight of stairs with a small heart for exercise, a metro train with a small calendar for Mondays. LEFT, inside the doorway: the broker, a man in his 40s (plum shirt, ID lanyard, clipboard) stands quietly, hands folded over the clipboard, mouth closed, with no bubble. The clipboard is shown in a small inset with three short lines, each with a small honest cross: stairs with no lift, a four, a metro icon with a long dashed line. A dashed arrow from the clipboard to the buyer shows the downsides were told first. Gentle morning light over the lake. The broker's quiet stance is clearly respectful, not sly. Labels: "NO LIFT" on the clipboard inset and "LAKE VIEW" above the lake.

key: Every family WhatsApp group has one aunt
name: ch15_two_aunts_family_group
alt: Two aunts in a family chat group: one posts only her son's achievements and gets muted, the other asks about everyone and gets the calls.
scene: A split-panel picture with a thin vertical divider, each half dominated by a large generic smartphone with a plain family chat screen (no app logos). LEFT panel: an aunt in her 50s (amber saree, gold bangles) stands proudly holding her phone; on the big phone screen her messages stack up: a graduation cap, an aeroplane, a car, a trophy, each a bubble from her, and the replies under them are only tiny thumbs-up icons. A small bell with a slash beside the phone shows the group being muted, and the bubbles fade slightly. RIGHT panel: a second aunt in her 60s (teal saree, spectacles) holds her phone; her messages are questions with question marks next to a small exam paper and a little house with a camera, and the replies are many colourful bubbles with photos and hearts from different relatives. Her phone rings with curved ring lines and a small incoming-call bubble, and a couple of small relative faces float around it. Mood: left lonely and loud, right warm and busy. Labels: "ABOUT ME" above the left phone and "ABOUT YOU" above the right phone.

key: A good cricket captain at a team meeting
name: ch15_captain_dressing_room
alt: A cricket captain goes round the dressing room asking players for their views, and his match plan on the board is built from what they tell him.
scene: Inside a cricket dressing room before a big match: wooden benches, kit bags, pads and bats leaning against lockers, and a whiteboard on the wall. CENTRE: the captain in his late 20s (teal team jersey with a small C badge, cap in hand) stands with a marker, turning to listen, not lecturing. AROUND him three players speak, each with a speech bubble holding one simple icon: the opener (padded up, helmet under arm) with a bubble showing a pitch strip with cracks; the spinner (sleeves rolled, ball in hand) with a bubble showing a water drop for evening dew; the wicketkeeper (gloves on) with a bubble showing a spinning ball with a question mark. From each bubble a dashed arrow runs to the whiteboard, where three matching pieces fit together like puzzle tiles into one plan with a field diagram. A fourth player sits on the bench nodding. Bright light from a window, team spirit mood, everyone leaning in. The captain's own mouth is closed and his marker hovers, waiting for the last player to finish before he writes the final line. Label: "TEAM PLAN" at the top of the whiteboard.
